description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Scrap Trawler spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
